text: Efficient and rapid intensive teaching mode, in which general Chinese teaching adopts centralized intensive language training mode, and specialized Chinese and specialized basic knowledge (mathematics, physics and chemistry, etc.) teaching adopts complementary habit education, which focuses on teaching core knowledge of related disciplines.We offer Chinese language courses based on skills to comprehensively improve students' listening, speaking, reading and writing skills, and provide HSK pre-test guidance, training and simulation tests.According to the discipline characteristics and professional requirements of the University of International Business and Economics (UIBE), we offer Chinese courses for bridging business courses, and math and English courses in the spring semester.Free experience of the "Business Chinese self-study and self-test system" independently developed by the college, a two-way combination of classroom learning and practical application.
